info.more-arrows.shared.firing: Fires from a bow, a crossbow, or a dispenser, and is picked back up the same way a vanilla arrow is.
info.more-arrows.grapple_arrow: Hooks into the first block it hits and reels the shooter to it. Fired beyond the configured range, it embeds without pulling.
info.more-arrows.rope_arrow: Anchors in the block it hits and drops a climbable rope beneath it, down to the configured length or until the rope meets the ground.
info.more-arrows.glow_ink_arrow: Marks the living entity it hits with the glowing effect for the configured duration, outlining it through terrain for every player on the server. It barely scratches what it tags.
info.more-arrows.redstone_arrow: Emits a redstone signal at the face it strikes, at the configured strength, until the configured duration runs out. The signal expires on its own, including across a chunk reload.
info.more-arrows.wind_arrow: Bursts on impact like a wind charge, opening the same doors, trapdoors, and gates, and shoving nearby entities away with force that falls off toward the edge of the burst. It never shoves the shooter.
info.more-arrows.gunpowder_arrow: Sticks where it lands, beeps down a configured fuse, then explodes at vanilla TNT strength. Terrain damage is off by default, so it rearranges mobs rather than builds until an operator says otherwise.
info.more-arrows.tnt_arrow: The second explosive tier, crafted from eight gunpowder arrows around a block of TNT. Shorter fuse and a bigger blast than the tier below it.
info.more-arrows.fire_charge_arrow: The largest explosion of the three tiers, crafted from eight TNT arrows around a fire charge, and the only one that leaves a fire patch behind.
info.more-arrows.incendiary_arrow: Fire without an explosion. On contact it sets every entity in the burn radius alight and lays a fire patch on the surface, with no blast and no terrain damage beyond what the fire itself does.
info.more-arrows.gravity_arrow: Drops the block it strikes, which then falls like vanilla sand and re-places itself where it lands. It affects only the block that was hit unless an operator raises the impact radius, it never moves an unbreakable block, and it goes down with the block it drops rather than being recovered.
info.more-arrows.ricochet_arrow: Glances off the surfaces it hits instead of embedding, reflecting like light off a mirror so a shot can be banked around a corner or off a ceiling. It runs out of bounces after the configured count and then embeds, recoverable as any arrow is. Hitting an entity is a normal arrow hit, never a bounce.
info.more-arrows.ender_pearl_arrow: Teleports the shooter to wherever it lands, at the range of a bow rather than of a throw, and deals the same arrival damage a thrown pearl does. Striking a mob puts the shooter where that mob stands. An arrow fired beyond the configured range, or at a destination outside the world border, moves nobody and embeds, recoverable as any arrow is, and a dispensed arrow has no shooter to move.
info.more-arrows.recall_arrow: The ender pearl arrow read backwards: the living thing it strikes is brought to the shooter instead. Players are left where they are unless an operator turns that on. A strike beyond the configured range moves nothing, hitting a block does nothing at all, and a dispensed arrow has no shooter to bring anything to.
